shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a rectangular island stands between a sink counter and a refrigerator, with a window along one side and an aisle along the opposite side. A man in a blue shirt sits on the sink-side window stool and explains the plan for managing morning housekeeping chores. A man in a purple shirt sits on the sink-end stool. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the refrigerator end, looking along the kitchen island toward the sink counter, with both window-side stools and the sink-end stool and the sink counter in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt enters and sits in the empty place. She asks about dividing the breakfast responsibilities, and a man in a blue shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side stools.

shots.content: A man in a blue shirt outlines the steps for cooking breakfast.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the kitchen island.
